test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/643fde1a0883e6a757090f30fd2abd4bfefd06803053262bcfb648e22e0a867f.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -1.

Let’s check each option:

1. QT-XS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0961dc06aec08c954ee460cbb39aff742a75908e9729b98a2a61b8f7b154ad7f.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -1.

2. EH-LG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4f2502c5d86f0dbc24250e0d98d8e002572ed32cbef83b903e52d02ab915a5f.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -1.

3. IL-PJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ffea0d2d6aa49ad456c4c5141acc10cc0205f237b9dbc6de027082e8ff36ce.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +7, -1.

4. MP-TO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/413e10ef3275e0b4235e9d98d2b5002d246a51c426fb5924b99a37681f8660b7.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +7, -1.

Thus, IL-PJ is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
